EDEN PERSONAL GRAND BACKUP — SCOPE v2.0

OWNER: Lucas Buzek DATE: 2026-09-22

This is not merely an App registry. It is a consolidated personal
working-data and AppDev seed backup intended to reconstruct useful
EDEN/edenOS Workspaces, workflows, Apps, Helpers, specialists and
agents.

INCLUDE: • EDEN identity, philosophy, Design Mantra, AppDevRules and
canon. • GrandMasterRegister and interaction profiles. • established
Apps, Products, Helpers, agents, subordinate specialists and
relationships. • HESPERA/HESTIA/GardenOS prototyping and engineering
history. • professional profile, portfolio, website, job/opportunity and
tender work. • hardware, electronics, repair, solar, automation and
embedded-system work. • travel research and planning. • agriculture,
greenhouse, poultry, agrivoltaics and sustainable-community work. •
publishing, media, creative and digital workflows. • private personal
context useful for personal Workspaces. • pseudonymous/anonymous
private-health Workspace schema. • reusable specialist/workflow
definitions so personal data can become broader edenOS/AppDev
capability.

DATA CLASSES: PUBLIC — deliberately shareable professional/project
material. PERSONAL — private operational context. PRIVATE — sensitive
personal material. PSEUDONYMOUS — sensitive records stored under a
private alias/token for specialist workflows. SECRET — passwords,
credentials, tokens and equivalent secrets. Do NOT duplicate into
general backups.

RULE: Personal data is source material for Lucas’s private Workspaces;
it is not automatically public EDEN product data. Broader edenOS
capabilities should be generalized from workflows and schemas, not by
shipping Lucas’s private records.
